data.one_liner: Get the IP address of the current device using https://api64.ipify.org.
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple mechanism to fetch the system IP address of the current device. Uses https://api64.ipify.org under the hood and supports json or text response types.
use_when: You need to retrieve the public IP address of the current device.
You want a straightforward way to fetch IP addresses with minimal configuration.
avoid_when: You need local network IP addresses rather than the external system IP.
You require an offline solution for obtaining IP addresses.
strengths: Simple and easy to use API
Supports multiple request types (json and text)
weaknesses: Depends on an external web service (ipify.org) to resolve the IP
Not documented for local network IP discovery
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package. No native platform permissions explicitly documented.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: You can make direct HTTP requests to IP lookup services without needing a dedicated wrapper package.

data.minimal_example:
var ipAddress = IpAddress(type: RequestType.json);
dynamic data = await ipAddress.getIpAddress();
